title: Festivals and Celebrations
subtitle: State processions, seasonal harvest observances, and temple fairs
description: Public observances and historic state festivals celebrating Karnataka's seasonal cycles, civic heritage, and classical processional traditions.
altText: Cultural performers during the annual Mysuru Dasara state festival celebrations in Mysuru, Karnataka.

title: Traditional Arts
subtitle: Classical court painting, mineral pigments, and dramatic theatre
description: Visual and theatrical disciplines refined through centuries of court and temple patronage, including gold-gilded Mysore paintings and coastal Yakshagana.
altText: Traditional gold-gilded Mysore school painting depicting Sri Cheluvarayaswamy.

title: Folk Music and Dance
subtitle: Ritual percussion ensembles, heroic ballads, and community dance
description: High-energy drum dances and rural performance traditions preserved by regional communities and documented by state cultural academies.
altText: Karnataka Dollu Kunitha folk drummers performing synchronized choreography with traditional cylindrical drums.

title: Historical Monuments
subtitle: UNESCO stone ensembles, rock-cut sanctuaries, and dynastic architecture
description: Built heritage spanning Early Chalukyan sandstone caves, Hoysala stellate soapstone temples, and the granite capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.
altText: The Garuda Stone Chariot and pillared mandapa of Vijaya Vittala Temple at Hampi.

title: Food and Cuisine
subtitle: Geographical Indication confections and regional culinary lineages
description: Distinctive regional preparations shaped by local agriculture, dairy traditions, and multi-generational culinary lineages.
altText: Caramelized deep-brown Dharwad Peda milk sweets lightly dusted with sugar crystals.

title: Handicrafts and Textiles
subtitle: GI-protected mulberry silk looms, lacquerware, and silver inlay
description: Material craft traditions protected under India's Geographical Indications framework, uniting natural pigments, pure zari, Ilkal looms, and Bidri metallurgy.
altText: Traditional handloom Mysore silk sarees woven with pure mulberry silk and gold zari borders.

title: Customs and Traditions
subtitle: Community forest stewardship and ancestral ecological covenants
description: Living social customs that safeguard biocultural landscapes, sacred groves, and shared community water and temple stewardship.
altText: Forested Western Ghats hillside and sacred watershed surrounding Talakaveri in Kodagu.
